title: Implement the daily cold email lane

model.name: gpt-6.1-terra
model.why: Available in the local Codex model list. High effort for compliance, replay and cross-stage wiring. No measured comparison found here; confirm the reference choice and recheck availability at dispatch.

interface:
Implement GET-GOING 1.3 via coldRows({context,research,gate,canon,at,taken,history,capabilities}) -> {rows,research,held,counts}; extend named_cold and daily dispatch, no parallel sender/store. Export coldRows from src/stages/cold.mjs.
Candidates: context's cold pools, signals and answered lookups only; dedupe; never a circle person, anyone with an open Jonny pitch, a brief taker, opt-out, bounce or anyone in his network; require routes[id].in_network===false. Missing eligibility holds.
Order: coldVerdict first, then scoreProspect joined to SCORERS (reasoned lead scorer, bump SCORE_VERSION), then researched until something specific is known: a cited fact on the person's or company's own record or the research desk's answer, else cold_nothing_specific. Reuse bounded research rounds; never invent facts or infer authority from title.
Require fresh readGate/approved footer and records.brief_takers; preserve all compliance holds. Emit v2 email actions, mailbox:krish, cold:{source_line}, report >=1.39.0; coldActionHold must pass. source_line names where we found them, <=200 characters, plain, no address/link. Body: one ask, at most one link, under 90 words; no footer. Use existing morning QA and voice check path, including after rewrites. Control Center adds footer and checks whole note; Krish sends.
One follow-up only, only with a new fact, only after an open: protocol follow_up/follows, features.follow_up, same recipient, sent >=3 days ago, recipient-class open after send, no reply/bounce/opt-out/open deal or prior follow-up; never mention the open. No follow-up chains.
At most 3 cold lane slots a day including follow-ups and repeat dispatches; honor tighter caps. Pause lane for 7 days when bounces exceed 3% of last 7 days' cold sends, or 3 opt-outs or negative replies arrive in a week, from context drafts: bounced_at, opted_out_at, replied_at with reply class if served. Unknown is not zero.
Counts only in activity lines and holds, never a name or address. New holds: cold_nothing_specific, cold_excluded, cold_score_low, cold_history_unread, cold_daily_cap, cold_paused, cold_note_invalid.
Tests on synthetic fixtures only; declare at least 4 mutations in invariants/mutations.json. Update docs/OWNERS.md and pipeline/stage-conveyor.json; GET-GOING 1.3 stays unticked for a human after a live run.

proof.description: Synthetic test names and killed mutation ids, counts and codes only. Cover: brief takers absent, footer mismatch, each exclusion, no cited fact, score rule-outs, 89/90 words, links and asks, source_line, follow-up rules, duplicate runs. Mutations remove compliance, the specific-fact rule, raise the cap, disable the pause: all killed.

notes.description: Context field mapping and gaps; never invent wire fields. Fail closed when eligibility or cold history is unread (cold_history_unread). Rolling 7-day cohort for bounces; unclassified replies are unknown, not negative. New York day boundaries; stable proposal ids; pending proposals use slots. Record built versus consumer-pending in RELEASE and a closeout note.
